lines: Ruling: Store locale/theme independently in the profile rather than Snapshot.settings — prevents preference updates invalidating live note CAS and keeps note schema3/old-version rollback stable — if wrong, UI preferences would need a later profile migration; backup guide must say note backups do not automatically transfer profile preferences.

Ruling: Continue the already-authorized validated main/push/private-prerelease workflow for this approved increment and use preview.3 — repository rules explicitly authorize stages, user approved V2 and asked to add app features; no destructive/public installation changes — if wrong, rework or revert the new stage, while .2 and .16 remain recoverable.

Ruling: Allow targeted SIGTERM only for verified owned startup-only synthetic PIDs2613/2738 blocked by synchronous native showErrorBox — normal app.quit/CDP cannot execute, no editing/composition/fault injection began, auxiliary permissions would require new authorization — if wrong, disposable fixture changes could be interrupted; keep snapshots/failure and mark forced cleanup, never normal exit/pass. Controller argv/profile ownership checked,30628protectedalive; no broad kill or user data deletion.

Ruling: Escalate to SIGKILL only reverified owned startup parents2613/2738 after normal app.quit/CDP and SIGTERM>10s all fail — synchronous native error modal blocks event/signal processing and prevents cleanup; no draft/IME/fault test began — if wrong, only synthetic startup state could be interrupted; retain failure snapshots/logs and verify descendants exit, never mark normalQuit/pass. Exactargv rechecked and30628alive, no broad process kill.

Ruling: Treat the new glass video as a separately archived material evaluation, leaving the currently frozen .3 increment unchanged — user explicitly says preserve main progress, and sample CSS shadows do not establish native Mac/Windows material compatibility — if wrong, polish is delayed until a bounded follow-up, while current source/test provenance stays reviewable.

Ruling: Resolve the Mac ASCII-launcher generator readiness in Task1 fix round1 before freezing both package inputs — the explicit final filename must match producer/output and a later generator change would invalidate same-source packages — if wrong, minor launcher regeneration work is added before build, while already delivered .2/.16 files stay unchanged.

Ruling: Generate final delivery facts outside the frozen source template and bind its SHA instead of updating included docs/delivery after builds — package hashes/actual outcomes only exist after building, and modifying an included template would invalidate both package input vectors — if wrong, guide provenance/wording needs correction before publication; current immutable source and old rollback packages remain recoverable.

Ruling: Repair packaged-test environment deletion and supervise the Playwright worker outside its crash boundary before any paired rebuild — official pinned Win/Mac environment contracts differ and the Node24 early-exit probe proves fixture finally can be skipped, while the retained historical runner does not prove exact child cause — if wrong, the small test-only layer needs rework; unchanged package/data assertions and both real-package gates still prevent false publication, with old packages and original failure evidence recoverable.

Ruling: Archive and remove only the owned RED invalid-Node temp profile after a fresh launch-command inventory finds no matching process and its sole file is verified synthetic seed — the old runner did not record child PIDs, so keep that historical gap while separately proving current cleanup ownership; no signal or application mutation — if wrong, only the synthetic seed could need restoration from the exact archived bytes, and no historical normal/tree-exit pass is inferred.

Ruling: Upload the entire 24-file delivery set to the unpublished private draft, with all 23 checksum targets present — the handoff guide requires a complete-directory SHA256SUMS check, whereas the initial 13-asset draft omits 11 targets — if wrong, a few small evidence assets and one source evidence ZIP cost download size; unchanged installers/source and retained partial readback remain recoverable.

Ruling: Include I1 plus nonblocking M1 in the single final fix wave, defer M2's unproven Windows warning caller without suppression — I1 already requires paired source rebuild, M1 has a bounded ownership-receipt regression, while speculative warning edits add no verified benefit — if wrong, a small test-stage change needs rework and the warning persists for later Windows maintenance; old failures/candidates and rollback releases remain recoverable.

Ruling: Keep each final-review Declined-to-judge behavior at its documented evidence tier rather than infer acceptance — physical sessions, future bytes and historical missing evidence cannot be proved by this source review; explicitly dispose each below — if wrong, further independent tests/review or material/media follow-up are required and any overstated historical proof must be corrected, while current candidate remains unpublished.

Ruling: Route the newly discovered CRLF-sensitive callback-extraction failure to the Task2 included-fixture portability gate — the consumer CI now proves a load-bearing unit-fixture failure, while production final I1/M1 fix already passed its ONE scoped review; require unchanged behavioral assertions, controlled LF/CRLF RED/GREEN and a focused Task2 review, then BOTH new-freeze rebuilds — if wrong, an extra CI/build pair and duplicate-cleanup time are spent; all old failures and candidates remain recoverable, with no speculative production changes or repeated broad final review.

Ruling: Repair the included Mac launcher generator for directory-relative fixed-hash isolation and verify real moved-bundle/missing/corrupt behavior before distribution — the consumer review identifies a transferable-download requirement that the local-path check could not prove, so update Task2 round3 and require a reviewed new freeze plus BOTH rebuilds; label stale audit snapshots and correct report banner without erasing history — if wrong, another bounded build pair and cleanup time are spent; unchanged app logic, old proofs and rollback versions remain recoverable.
